text: I find myself in a modern innovation space—perhaps a research center or a museum exhibit—devoted to the intersection of technology and human experience. The atmosphere feels open and designed for reflection, with glass walls and vivid information displays. I am struck by the invitation to ponder progress and coexistence with technology. Being here, I feel a mixture of curiosity and humility, aware of how much there is to learn from the unknown and the ever-shifting boundary between human and machine.
